Team — internal note and proposed approach (draft attached):

Summary of issue:
- Stratus (consultancy) and MountainStack (ISV) are both working ACME Retail in overlapping business units (US-East) and points of contact.
- Risk: duplicate customer outreach, quoting, and potential contract confusion.

Proposed resolution (high level):
1) Territory/account split: Redwood will maintain primary sales ownership of ACME enterprise contract. Partners will be given named POC access with agreed seats of influence:
   - Stratus: Professional Services / Integration delivery for Fulfillment and Inventory (regional scope: US-East ops)
   - MountainStack: ISV analytics add-on (pilot scope: single BU, non-commercial until pilot complete)
2) Commercial model: referral fee for Stratus on PS bookings + revenue-share on any resale of Redwood capacity within their scope. MountainStack will be treated as an ISV partner with listing/lead credits while pilot is active.
3) Mutual Action Plan (MAP): agree on named accounts, contact matrix, outreach cadence, and a DocuSign signoff for the coverage map.

Action items I propose:
- Vanessa: produce a draft account map (see redwood-stratus_account_map_v1.xlsx attached).
- Tessa: check existing POC/contract flags in Salesforce and flag any legal/NDAs.
- Markus: approve the revenue-share bands for Stratus (we should keep this in line with current partner list pricing).

I recommend we send a one-page proposed coverage map to Stratus + MountainStack for signoff, then route to legal for a short MOU.

[Attachment: redwood-stratus_account_map_v1.xlsx (xlsx) — draft, 42KB]

Thanks,
Sergio
